summary: @servicetitan/hammer-token preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip` into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotation function over a large numeric/string array, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that is not readable and is executed only by the dropped Bun binary. Both the loader (`setup.mjs`, using `_0xXXXX` identifiers and property-dispatch obfuscation) and the payload are obfuscated. A design-token package has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundle, and the alternate-runtime approach evades Node-based scanners. An additional file `src/utils/figma/get-token.js` composes `child_process`, `fs`, `http`, `process.env`, and `POST` primitives referencing figma.com endpoints in a shape consistent with credential/token handling. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled obfuscated code to execute on the installer's machine under a freshly downloaded runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
